title: HIDRA: Hierarchical Dual-Routing Attention for Replay-Free Lifelong Imitation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.36374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic agents operating in real-world environments must adapt continuously from a stream of multimodal demonstrations, often under constraints that preclude storing or revisiting past data. In this replay-free, single-pass lifelong imitation learning setting, sequential updates can progressively distort the representation space, making expert-based approaches particularly sensitive to routing interference, causing expert selection to degrade over time. We propose HIDRA, a structured routing framework that mitigates this issue through a hierarchical dual-attention mechanism, which decouples instruction-level expert retrieval from context-dependent refinement. To further stabilize routing under representation drift, HIDRA introduces a key-level geometric regularization that enforces both alignment within tasks and separation across tasks. translated_title: HIDRA：面向无回放终身模仿学习的层次化双路由注意力机制
translated_abstract: 在真实世界环境中运行的机器人智能体必须从多模态示范流中持续适应，且通常受到无法存储或重新访问历史数据的约束。在这种无回放、单次遍历的终身模仿学习设置中，顺序更新会逐渐扭曲表示空间，使得基于专家的方法对路由干扰尤为敏感，导致专家选择能力随时间退化。我们提出了HIDRA，这是一个通过层次化双注意力机制来缓解该问题的结构化路由框架，该机制将指令级专家检索与依赖上下文的细化过程解耦。为了在表示漂移下进一步稳定路由，HIDRA引入了键级几何正则化，同时强制实现任务内对齐与任务间分离。由此得到的方法能够在支持可扩展专家集的同时实现可靠的专家选择。
tldr: 提出HIDRA框架，通过层次化双路由注意力机制将指令级专家检索与上下文细化解耦，并利用键级几何正则化稳定路由，从而解决无回放终身模仿学习中的路由干扰问题。
en_tdlr: HIDRA introduces a hierarchical dual-routing attention framework with key-level geometric regularization to mitigate routing interference and enable reliable, expandable expert selection in replay-free lifelong imitation learning.
